nameStatus: Selected as working name by user
intendedAudience: Middle-aged and older men and women living with diabetes who require protein intake.

directions.name: Morning Gold
directions.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE exceptional photorealistic packaging hero image, portrait 2:3, one complete 500 g nutrition package. Brand: TRAYN Nutrition. Product working name: Radiance. This is a luxurious DAILY-CONSUMPTION protein product concept for middle-aged and older men and women. The visual feeling is warm, fresh, full of life, glowy, sunshiny, beautiful and welcoming. Design the packaging as a valued everyday pantry object, with the sophistication of premium food packaging and outstanding readable typography.
Reference image 1 is for the EXACT TRAYN symbol and TRAYN NUTRITION wordmark geometry only. Preserve their recognizable shapes and spelling, recolored as appropriate for this palette. Completely reimagine the reference graphic layout and product name. Do not recreate its green pouch, sports typography or sweeping bands.
Exact front label copy: "TRAYN" and "NUTRITION" as the preserved brand lockup; "Radiance" prominently; "DAILY PROTEIN" beneath it; "BELGIAN CHOCOLATE"; "500 g"; "Contains Milk"; and unobtrusive but legible "PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE". All copy printed on the package; no floating captions. Radiance must remain exceptionally readable, with refined well-spaced typography rather than a fragile script. Warm dark ink on light surfaces for main text; gold accents complement rather than replace readable lettering.
Make the warm glow tangible in the actual print design, color and material, as well as the lighting. Luxurious but welcoming for use every morning. Maintain food/nutrition identity with the DAILY PROTEIN descriptor and small chocolate flavor detail. The working flavor and pack size are visual placeholders.
No extra health or nutrition claims, diabetes suitability statements, blood glucose promises, sugar claims, certification marks, invented protein gram figures or nutritional data. No medical icons, people, athletic imagery, beauty/skincare copy, new monogram or replacement logo.
Photography: one full package with breathing room around all edges and an almost frontal three-quarter view. Sunlit ivory and pale honey studio setting, delicate directional morning shadows, realistic soft daylight bloom, believable material highlights, beautiful natural contact shadow. Restrained pale limestone surface. Crystal-clear product and printed lettering, slightly softened background. No collage or comparison board.
DIRECTION 1: A premium broad ivory cylindrical FOOD TIN, gently rounded shoulders, removable softly brushed champagne-gold metal lid, fine realistic rolled rim and label seam. Face is mostly luminous warm ivory with the preserved dark bronze TRAYN identity modestly above a large exquisitely set dark-espresso Radiance in a beautiful contemporary serif. DAILY PROTEIN in spaced readable small caps. Below the name, a restrained debossed sun disc surrounded by a few fine concentric champagne-foil rays, tangible low-relief detail that catches the morning light without becoming a new logo. One narrow pale honey band near the bottom, small cocoa line drawing by the flavor. Keep the tin clean, tailored, and impeccably balanced, with visibly premium warm material quality. Subtle golden bounce light, quiet luxury, beautiful daily nourishment.
